prompts.name: jelly33
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent pixel-art game VFX sprite sheet. Reference image is style/palette only: cute mint jelly creature with white tuft and coral eyes, no creature should appear in output. Create ONE square RGBA transparent sprite sheet arranged as a precise 3 columns by 2 rows equal grid, six isolated centered sprites with generous transparent margins, no grid lines or labels. Top row: three variants of airborne soft mint jelly droplets, plump irregular pear-shaped / oblong blobs, very readable compact silhouettes with a small bright creamy highlight, darker teal 1-pixel outline, 4-6 restrained colour ramps. Bottom row: three variants of flat irregular jelly splats seen directly from above, a connected puddle with a few small lobes, no tall splash crowns, no perspective ellipse, no cast shadow. The top sprites face the viewer and will be billboarded in a 3D game; the bottom splats will be mapped onto the real ground, do not bake a 25-degree camera angle. Crisp low-resolution pixel-art appearance about 24-32 logical pixels per sprite, large clean pixel clusters and limited colours, matching the reference creature's hand-drawn pixel aesthetic. Each sprite occupies about 60 percent of its cell. Actual fully transparent background and transparent gutters; no checkerboard painted into image. Avoid photographic glass, smooth vector icons, excessive tiny sparkles, gradients, faces, text, scenery, existing character, and black/white background.

prompts.name: sugar33
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent pixel-art VFX sprite sheet for cute warm fantasy game, using reference solely for pixel-art treatment and palette harmony. Create ONE square RGBA transparent sprite sheet, precise 3 columns by 2 rows equal grid, six separate centered assets with large transparent gutters, NO drawn grid or labels. Six distinct broken HARD CANDY CHIPS: top row three large irregular angular thin fragments, bottom row three smaller compact angular crumbs. Ivory pearl sugar with a delicate blush-pink edge, tiny peach shadow plane and single white specular face. Fractured planes and bevelled polygon silhouettes, asymmetrical triangles and chipped trapezoids; no star shapes, no diamonds-as-gems, no magical sparkle rays, no intact sweets or wrappers. Draw face-on chips as reusable sprite cutouts; motion and 3D orientation will be handled by the engine. Solid readable candy body rather than glow, no baked ground shadow. Crisp genuine pixel-art look about 20-28 logical pixels per piece, limited 5-7 colours, chunky clean clusters and subtle darker warm mauve contour, matching the reference creature and character style. Occupy 55-65 percent of each cell. Fully transparent alpha background, no painted checkerboard, no scenery, no words, no lettering.
